en: Deuteronomy 32

p.src: 1  Give ear, you heavens, and I will speak. Let the earth hear the words of my mouth.

en: Give ear, you heavens, and I will speak. Let the earth hear the words of my mouth.
u.src: 1  Give ear, you heavens, and I will speak. Let the earth hear the words of my mouth.

p.src: 2  My doctrine will drop as the rain. My speech will condense as the dew, as the misty rain on the tender grass, as the showers on the herb.

en: My doctrine will drop as the rain. My speech will condense as the dew, as the misty rain on the tender grass, as the showers on the herb.
u.src: 2  My doctrine will drop as the rain. My speech will condense as the dew, as the misty rain on the tender grass, as the showers on the herb.

p.src: 3  For I will proclaim the LORD’s name. Ascribe greatness to our God!

ja: らせる。 わたしたちの
en: For I will proclaim the LORD’s name. Ascribe greatness to our God!
u.src: 3  For I will proclaim the LORD’s name. Ascribe greatness to our God!

p.src: 4  The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.

en: The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.
u.src: 4  The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.

p.src: 5  They have dealt corruptly with him. They are not his children, because of their defect. They are a perverse and crooked generation.

ja: ら自身の汚点ゆえに。 曲がった、よこしまな
en: They have dealt corruptly with him. They are not his children, because of their defect. They are a perverse and crooked generation.
u.src: 5  They have dealt corruptly with him. They are not his children, because of their defect. They are a perverse and crooked generation.

p.src: 6  Is this the way you repay the LORD, foolish and unwise people? Isn’t he your father who has bought you? He has made you and established you.

ja: ではないか。 あなたを形
en: Is this the way you repay the LORD, foolish and unwise people? Isn’t he your father who has bought you? He has made you and established you.
u.src: 6  Is this the way you repay the LORD, foolish and unwise people? Isn’t he your father who has bought you? He has made you and established you.

p.src: 7  Remember the days of old. Consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; your elders, and they will tell you.

en: Remember the days of old. Consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; your elders, and they will tell you.
u.src: 7  Remember the days of old. Consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; your elders, and they will tell you.

p.src: 8  When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the children of men, he set the bounds of the peoples according to the number of the children of Israel.

ja: けられたとき、 イスラエルの
en: When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the children of men, he set the bounds of the peoples according to the number of the children of Israel.
u.src: 8  When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the children of men, he set the bounds of the peoples according to the number of the children of Israel.

p.src: 9  For the LORD’s portion is his people. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.

ja: 、 ヤコブは主の受け継ぐ
en: For the LORD’s portion is his people. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
u.src: 9  For the LORD’s portion is his people. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.

p.src: 10  He found him in a desert land, in the waste howling wilderness. He surrounded him. He cared for him. He kept him as the apple of his eye.

ja: いだし、 獣のほえる荒涼の荒野で見つけられた。
み、いたわり、 ご自分のひとみのように
en: He found him in a desert land, in the waste howling wilderness. He surrounded him. He cared for him. He kept him as the apple of his eye.
u.src: 10  He found him in a desert land, in the waste howling wilderness. He surrounded him. He cared for him. He kept him as the apple of his eye.

p.src: 11  As an eagle that stirs up her nest, that flutters over her young, he spread abroad his wings, he took them, he bore them on his feathers.

ja: を揺り起こし、 雛の
en: As an eagle that stirs up her nest, that flutters over her young, he spread abroad his wings, he took them, he bore them on his feathers.
u.src: 11  As an eagle that stirs up her nest, that flutters over her young, he spread abroad his wings, he took them, he bore them on his feathers.

p.src: 12  The LORD alone led him. There was no foreign god with him.

en: The LORD alone led him. There was no foreign god with him.
u.src: 12  The LORD alone led him. There was no foreign god with him.

p.src: 13  He made him ride on the high places of the earth. He ate the increase of the field. He caused him to suck honey out of the rock, oil out of the flinty rock;

en: He made him ride on the high places of the earth. He ate the increase of the field. He caused him to suck honey out of the rock, oil out of the flinty rock;
u.src: 13  He made him ride on the high places of the earth. He ate the increase of the field. He caused him to suck honey out of the rock, oil out of the flinty rock;

p.src: 14  butter from the herd, and milk from the flock, with fat of lambs, rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the finest of the wheat. From the blood of the grape, you drank wine.

ja: 肪、 バシャン育ちの
え、 あなたはぶどうの
en: butter from the herd, and milk from the flock, with fat of lambs, rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the finest of the wheat. From the blood of the grape, you drank wine.
u.src: 14  butter from the herd, and milk from the flock, with fat of lambs, rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the finest of the wheat. From the blood of the grape, you drank wine.

p.src: 15  But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned God who made him, and rejected the Rock of his salvation.

ja: り上げた。 あなたは太り、
え、 つややかになった。 そして
en: But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned God who made him, and rejected the Rock of his salvation.
u.src: 15  But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned God who made him, and rejected the Rock of his salvation.

p.src: 16  They moved him to jealousy with strange gods. They provoked him to anger with abominations.

en: They moved him to jealousy with strange gods. They provoked him to anger with abominations.
u.src: 16  They moved him to jealousy with strange gods. They provoked him to anger with abominations.

p.src: 17  They sacrificed to demons, not God, to gods that they didn’t know, to new gods that came up recently, which your fathers didn’t dread.

ja: らは神ではない悪霊にいけにえをささげた。
れもしなかったものに。
en: They sacrificed to demons, not God, to gods that they didn’t know, to new gods that came up recently, which your fathers didn’t dread.
u.src: 17  They sacrificed to demons, not God, to gods that they didn’t know, to new gods that came up recently, which your fathers didn’t dread.

p.src: 18  Of the Rock who became your father, you are unmindful, and have forgotten God who gave you birth.

ja: を忘れ、 あなたを産み出した
en: Of the Rock who became your father, you are unmindful, and have forgotten God who gave you birth.
u.src: 18  Of the Rock who became your father, you are unmindful, and have forgotten God who gave you birth.

p.src: 19  The LORD saw and abhorred, because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.

ja: けられた。 息子、娘たちの背きゆえに。
en: The LORD saw and abhorred, because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.
u.src: 19  The LORD saw and abhorred, because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.

p.src: 20  He said, “I will hide my face from them. I will see what their end will be; for they are a very perverse generation, children in whom is no faithfulness.

en: He said, “I will hide my face from them. I will see what their end will be; for they are a very perverse generation, children in whom is no faithfulness.
u.src: 20  He said, “I will hide my face from them. I will see what their end will be; for they are a very perverse generation, children in whom is no faithfulness.

p.src: 21  They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God. They have provoked me to anger with their vanities. I will move them to jealousy with those who are not a people. I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.

ja: でないものによって、わたしのねたみを
en: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God. They have provoked me to anger with their vanities. I will move them to jealousy with those who are not a people. I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
u.src: 21  They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God. They have provoked me to anger with their vanities. I will move them to jealousy with those who are not a people. I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.

p.src: 22  For a fire is kindled in my anger, that burns to the lowest Sheol, devours the earth with its increase, and sets the foundations of the mountains on fire.

ja: がり、 よみ の底にまで
en: For a fire is kindled in my anger, that burns to the lowest Sheol, devours the earth with its increase, and sets the foundations of the mountains on fire.
u.src: 22  For a fire is kindled in my anger, that burns to the lowest Sheol, devours the earth with its increase, and sets the foundations of the mountains on fire.

ja: 32:22 よみ（シェオル）は死者の場所である。
en: 32:22 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 23  “I will heap evils on them. I will spend my arrows on them.

en: “I will heap evils on them. I will spend my arrows on them.
u.src: 23  “I will heap evils on them. I will spend my arrows on them.

p.src: 24  They shall be wasted with hunger, and devoured with burning heat and bitter destruction. I will send the teeth of animals on them, with the venom of vipers that glide in the dust.

en: They shall be wasted with hunger, and devoured with burning heat and bitter destruction. I will send the teeth of animals on them, with the venom of vipers that glide in the dust.
u.src: 24  They shall be wasted with hunger, and devoured with burning heat and bitter destruction. I will send the teeth of animals on them, with the venom of vipers that glide in the dust.

p.src: 25  Outside the sword will bereave, and in the rooms, terror on both young man and virgin, the nursing infant with the gray-haired man.

en: Outside the sword will bereave, and in the rooms, terror on both young man and virgin, the nursing infant with the gray-haired man.
u.src: 25  Outside the sword will bereave, and in the rooms, terror on both young man and virgin, the nursing infant with the gray-haired man.

p.src: 26  I said that I would scatter them afar. I would make their memory to cease from among men;

en: I said that I would scatter them afar. I would make their memory to cease from among men;
u.src: 26  I said that I would scatter them afar. I would make their memory to cease from among men;

p.src: 27  were it not that I feared the provocation of the enemy, lest their adversaries should judge wrongly, lest they should say, ‘Our hand is exalted; the LORD has not done all this.’”

ja: の嘲りを恐れた。 敵が
利した。 主がこれを行ったのではない』と
en: were it not that I feared the provocation of the enemy, lest their adversaries should judge wrongly, lest they should say, ‘Our hand is exalted; the LORD has not done all this.’”
u.src: 27  were it not that I feared the provocation of the enemy, lest their adversaries should judge wrongly, lest they should say, ‘Our hand is exalted; the LORD has not done all this.’”

p.src: 28  For they are a nation void of counsel. There is no understanding in them.

en: For they are a nation void of counsel. There is no understanding in them.
u.src: 28  For they are a nation void of counsel. There is no understanding in them.

p.src: 29  Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!

ja: わりを見極めたならよかったのに。
en: Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
u.src: 29  Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!

p.src: 30  How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had delivered them up?

ja: させられよう。 彼らの岩が彼らを売り、 主が引き渡されたのでなければ。
en: How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had delivered them up?
u.src: 30  How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had delivered them up?

p.src: 31  For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves concede.

ja: ばない。 敵さえ、それを認めている。
en: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves concede.
u.src: 31  For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves concede.

p.src: 32  For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, of the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poison grapes. Their clusters are bitter.

ja: から伸びたもの。 そのぶどうは
en: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, of the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poison grapes. Their clusters are bitter.
u.src: 32  For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, of the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poison grapes. Their clusters are bitter.

p.src: 33  Their wine is the poison of serpents, the cruel venom of asps.

en: Their wine is the poison of serpents, the cruel venom of asps.
u.src: 33  Their wine is the poison of serpents, the cruel venom of asps.

p.src: 34  “Isn’t this laid up in store with me, sealed up among my treasures?

ja: じられているではないか。
en: “Isn’t this laid up in store with me, sealed up among my treasures?
u.src: 34  “Isn’t this laid up in store with me, sealed up among my treasures?

p.src: 35  Vengeance is mine, and recompense, at the time when their foot slides, for the day of their calamity is at hand. Their doom rushes at them.”

ja: 彼らの足がよろめく時、
en: Vengeance is mine, and recompense, at the time when their foot slides, for the day of their calamity is at hand. Their doom rushes at them.”
u.src: 35  Vengeance is mine, and recompense, at the time when their foot slides, for the day of their calamity is at hand. Their doom rushes at them.”

p.src: 36  For the LORD will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone, that there is no one remaining, shut up or left at large.

ja: き、 しもべたちをあわれまれる。
も、だれも残らないのを
en: For the LORD will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone, that there is no one remaining, shut up or left at large.
u.src: 36  For the LORD will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone, that there is no one remaining, shut up or left at large.

p.src: 37  He will say, “Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge,

ja: 々はどこにいる。 避け所とした
en: He will say, “Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge,
u.src: 37  He will say, “Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge,

p.src: 38  which ate the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise up and help you! Let them be your protection.

ja: んだ神々は。 それらを
けさせよ。 それらをあなたがたの隠れ場とせよ。
en: which ate the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise up and help you! Let them be your protection.
u.src: 38  which ate the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise up and help you! Let them be your protection.

p.src: 39  “See now that I myself am he. There is no god with me. I kill and I make alive. I wound and I heal. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand.

ja: よ。わたしこそ、それである。 わたしのほかに
はいない。 わたしは
en: “See now that I myself am he. There is no god with me. I kill and I make alive. I wound and I heal. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand.
u.src: 39  “See now that I myself am he. There is no god with me. I kill and I make alive. I wound and I heal. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand.

p.src: 40  For I lift up my hand to heaven and declare, as I live forever,

en: For I lift up my hand to heaven and declare, as I live forever,
u.src: 40  For I lift up my hand to heaven and declare, as I live forever,

p.src: 41  if I sharpen my glittering sword, my hand grasps it in judgment; I will take vengeance on my adversaries, and will repay those who hate me.

en: if I sharpen my glittering sword, my hand grasps it in judgment; I will take vengeance on my adversaries, and will repay those who hate me.
u.src: 41  if I sharpen my glittering sword, my hand grasps it in judgment; I will take vengeance on my adversaries, and will repay those who hate me.

p.src: 42  I will make my arrows drunk with blood. My sword shall devour flesh with the blood of the slain and the captives, from the head of the leaders of the enemy.”

ja: わせ、 わたしの剣は肉を食らう。
en: I will make my arrows drunk with blood. My sword shall devour flesh with the blood of the slain and the captives, from the head of the leaders of the enemy.”
u.src: 42  I will make my arrows drunk with blood. My sword shall devour flesh with the blood of the slain and the captives, from the head of the leaders of the enemy.”

p.src: 43  Rejoice, you nations, with his people, for he will avenge the blood of his servants. He will take vengeance on his adversaries, and will make atonement for his land and for his people.

en: Rejoice, you nations, with his people, for he will avenge the blood of his servants. He will take vengeance on his adversaries, and will make atonement for his land and for his people.
u.src: 43  Rejoice, you nations, with his people, for he will avenge the blood of his servants. He will take vengeance on his adversaries, and will make atonement for his land and for his people.

ja: 32:43 この節について、七十人訳はこう読んでいる。「天よ、彼とともに喜べ。神のすべての御使いたちは彼を礼拝せよ。異邦人よ、彼の民とともに喜べ。神のすべての子らは彼にあって力を得よ。彼はその子らの血の復讐をし、復讐を与え、敵に正義を報い、彼を憎む者たちに報いられるからである。主はその民の地をきよめられる。」
en: 32:43 For this verse, LXX reads: Rejoice, you heavens, with him, and let all the angels of God worship him; rejoice you Gentiles, with his people, and let all the sons of God strengthen themselves in him; for he will avenge the blood of his sons, and he will give vengeance, and recompense justice to his enemies, and will reward them that hate him; and the Lord shall purge the land of his people.

p.src: 44  Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.

ja: ヨシュアとともに来て、この
en: Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.
u.src: 44  Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.

p.src: 45  Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel.

en: Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel.
u.src: 45  Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel.

p.src: 46  He said to them, “Set your heart to all the words which I testify to you today, which you shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.

ja: うよう、子供たちに命じなさい。
en: He said to them, “Set your heart to all the words which I testify to you today, which you shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.
u.src: 46  He said to them, “Set your heart to all the words which I testify to you today, which you shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.

p.src: 47  For it is no vain thing for you, because it is your life, and through this thing you shall prolong your days in the land, where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”

ja: これはあなたがたにとって
しい言葉ではない。あなたがたの
そのものである。この言葉によって、所有するためにヨルダン
く生きることができる。」
en: For it is no vain thing for you, because it is your life, and through this thing you shall prolong your days in the land, where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”

en: The LORD spoke to Moses that same day, saying,
u.src: 48  The LORD spoke to Moses that same day, saying,

p.src: 49  “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is across from Jericho; and see the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel for a possession.

ja: にあるアバリム山地のネボ山に登り、わたしがイスラエルの
en: “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is across from Jericho; and see the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel for a possession.
u.src: 49  “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is across from Jericho; and see the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel for a possession.

p.src: 50  Die on the mountain where you go up, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor, and was gathered to his people;

ja: えられたように、あなたも登るその山で死に、自分の民に加えられなさい。
en: Die on the mountain where you go up, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor, and was gathered to his people;
u.src: 50  Die on the mountain where you go up, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor, and was gathered to his people;

p.src: 51  because you trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because you didn’t uphold my holiness among the children of Israel.

ja: あなたがたはツィンの
らの間にあってわたしに
として示さなかったからである。
en: because you trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because you didn’t uphold my holiness among the children of Israel.
u.src: 51  because you trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because you didn’t uphold my holiness among the children of Israel.

ja: あなたは遠くからその
る。しかし、わたしがイスラエルの
